title: Capacity measurement excludes the query section, so a profile lore check certifies can still drop a declared source by budget on a real task
description:
FOUND IN THE FIELD by opum-doc and relayed through opum-agent (2026-10-01); INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED here 2026-10-01 against a fixture of my own, on the dev source AND the released 0.12.0 binary (the global `lore`, @opum-ai/lore 0.12.0). The relay asked for confirmation against my own fixture rather than its word, so nothing below is taken on the relay. The opum-doc instance is origin, not evidence: their review.toml at max_tokens 10000 rendered a 9151-token pack with a declared source omitted-by-budget, and their landing revision removed the source, so I did not reconstruct it.

WHAT I MEASURED. `lore check`'s agent-profile-capacity measurement excludes the bundle-wide query section a real `lore agent context` pack renders, so a profile the gate certifies can still have a declared source dropped by budget on a real task.

Fixture: docs/evidence/alpha (~2.9k declared) and docs/evidence/beta (~0.7k declared); the task "zephyr migration quirk" matches three NON-declared docs, so a real pack carries a full three-hit query section. Regenerable from /tmp/lore-cap-repro/probe.ts (scratch, not committed).
  - The measurement (declaredTokens) = 2957; profile max_tokens = 2982 (declared + 25).
  - `lore check`: exit 0 -- "Agent profiles: 1 read, 0 over capacity", 0 errors, 0 warnings, no finding.
  - `lore agent context probe --task "zephyr migration quirk"`: tokenEstimate 2297, truncated true, catalog reason for evidence/beta = "omitted-by-budget", 0 of 1 candidates selected.
  - CONTROL at the same budget with query hits OFF (compileAgentContextWithoutQueryHits): 2950, truncated false, every declared candidate selected.
So the delta is the query section alone: ~66 tokens in this minimal fixture, and 200-300 tokens measured across three sample tasks on this repository's own bundle (2026-10-01). Any profile with less headroom than that is certified green and still drops declared evidence on a real task.

WHY IT IS A DEFECT AND NOT ONLY A LIMITATION. The spec bullet this gate was built to (docs/specs/agent-profile-context-retrieval.md on origin/dev, ~line 98) says the measurement "is the size of the set as a real pack renders it -- the per-item and catalog score annotations included -- so a budget that satisfies it cannot start dropping declared evidence on a task". That second clause is false as written for any task whose pack carries a query section. The [pack-size] case in test/check-agent-profile-capacity.test.ts compares only against the hit-free compiler, so nothing in the suite pins the promise.

WHAT IS ALREADY ESTABLISHED, which changes the remedy and not the finding. LCLI-642's own notes record the exclusion as DELIBERATE -- the measurement renders "with no task and no query section" -- and the budgets it chose carry >=4500-5000 tokens of headroom precisely so that "a real task's bundle-wide query section, which is NOT part of the declared-set measurement" is covered by headroom (its notes 44, 57 and 87, measured 2026-09-29; re-confirmed here, margins 2155-5114 today). But that rule lives only in task notes and in the chosen numbers: "headroom" appears nowhere in docs/, and the runbook's budget section (docs/runbooks/agent-profile-operation.md, "Choosing a max_tokens budget") never mentions the query section. The surfaces operators and agents actually read disagree with the notes.

THE DECISION THIS NEEDS, before implementation -- a design question, routed through opum-agent to opum-doc for the operator; this record does not choose:
  (a) Keep the deliberate measurement and repair the spec: narrow the bullet so it promises only what the measurement provides, and state the headroom rule where operators read it (the runbook's budget section).
  (b) Make the measurement stand for the real pack by accounting for the query section task-independently (for example reserve its worst case), making the bullet true as written. This is the reading F2 already established for score annotations (the measurement must not be smaller than the pack it stands for), and it is a gate-behavior change: profiles now inside the window -- opum-doc's is one -- would newly warn. Under DEC-11 that argues the strengthened boundary should ship as a warning at least one release before LCLI-646's error flip.

WHY IT MATTERS TO LCLI-646. The flip turns this rule into an error. After it, a green `lore check` would certify at error severity a profile that drops declared evidence on real tasks -- the exact failure DEC-11 exists to catch, in the one direction the gate cannot see.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The operator's chosen reconciliation is recorded on this task through opum-agent/opum-doc before any change lands, naming which reading holds: the measurement accounts for the query section, or the spec bullet is narrowed and the headroom rule is documented where operators read it.

The change implements the recorded choice and nothing else. If the measurement is strengthened: a committed fixture with three bundle-wide hits compiles, at the certified budget, a pack that drops no candidate of any declared source, and the same fixture run against 0.12.0 fails it, with the pre-change measurement recorded beside it. If the spec is narrowed instead: the capacity bullet in docs/specs/agent-profile-context-retrieval.md no longer promises what the measurement does not provide, and the runbook says what covers the query section.
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0, and lore-cli's own four profiles emit no capacity finding before or after the change.

plan: 1. ADR-0025 recording DEC-98 B: the reserve definition, the score-width completion, the residuals.
2. Implement the worst-case query-section reserve and the full-width score placeholder in measureAgentProfileCapacity.
3. Update the finding message, the spec bullet, the runbook and CHANGELOG; sync the lore index.
4. Tests: the LCLI-662 repro becomes the property case; [pack-size] repointed at a matching task; predicted mutation subsets recorded.
5. bun test + bun run lore check green; lore-cli own profiles unchanged; reviewer pass before landing.
